text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Even if it's due to renovations,
having the Tenno Sho (Autumn) at Nakayama feels so fresh.
It's always at Tokyo, so it feels kind of weird.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wonder who's showing up this year...
Probably last year's queen who took the Double Tiara, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, what are you saying? It's Narita Top Road's time!
She's definitely going to win today!! Go for it!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Today's Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Kris S-san, entering from the Classic class,
will be facing the wall of the Senior class—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm sure Kris S-san will...! No matter who the opponent is, she won't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Symboli Kris S calmly focuses
just as she always does today,
preparing to face the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, there was something novel in the way she stood today—
I could sense a newfound "resolve" unlike anything before...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (...A piercing aura of intimidation. So this is the atmosphere of a race with the Senior Class... But—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—No problem.
That's what all the training was for.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch—that's Classic tier...?
It's spiked way higher than the data from just before...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Her aura is already that intense—
Still, bring it on...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (For Master's sake... for the sake of those walking beside me...——)
